import {
  internalAction,
  internalMutation,
  internalQuery,
} from "./_generated/server";
import { components } from "./_generated/api";
import { makeFunctionReference } from "convex/server";
import { listMessages } from "@convex-dev/agent";
import { v } from "convex/values";
export const setup = internalMutation({
  args: { userId: v.string(), appId: v.string() },
  handler: async (ctx, { userId, appId }) => {
    const thread = await ctx.runMutation(
      components.agent.threads.createThread,
      { userId, title: "fixture" },
    );
    await ctx.db.insert("apps", {
      appId,
      userId,
      name: "fixture",
      platforms: ["web"],
      features: [],
      expoAccountId: null,
      agentRemoteUnresolved: false,
      agentResumeBusy: false,
      agent: {
        threadId: thread._id,
        status: "idle",
        pending: [],
        updatedAt: Date.now(),
      },
    });
    await ctx.db.insert("publicAdmissionTransport", {
      userId,
      mode: "low",
      calls: 0,
    });
    return { threadId: thread._id };
  },
});
export const mode = internalMutation({
  args: { mode: v.string() },
  handler: async (ctx, { mode }) => {
    const row = await ctx.db.query("publicAdmissionTransport").first();
    if (!row) throw new Error("missing adapter");
    await ctx.db.patch(row._id, { mode });
  },
});
export const observe = internalMutation({
  args: { method: v.string(), body: v.any() },
  handler: async (ctx, { method, body }) => {
    if (
      method !== "customers.get_or_create" ||
      typeof body.customer_id !== "string"
    )
      throw new Error("unexpected request");
    const row = await ctx.db.query("publicAdmissionTransport").first();
    if (!row) throw new Error("missing adapter");
    if (body.customer_id !== row.userId) throw new Error("unexpected customer");
    await ctx.db.patch(row._id, { calls: row.calls + 1 });
    return row.mode;
  },
});
export const transport = internalAction({
  args: { method: v.string(), body: v.any() },
  handler: async (ctx, args) => {
    const mode = await ctx.runMutation(
      makeFunctionReference("publicAdmissionFixture:observe") as any,
      args,
    );
    if (mode === "error") throw new Error("synthetic provider failure");
    return mode === "low"
      ? { balances: { credits: { remaining: 9 } } }
      : mode === "ok"
        ? { balances: { credits: { remaining: 10 } } }
        : {};
  },
});
export const seedActive = internalMutation({
  args: { userId: v.string() },
  handler: async (ctx, { userId }) => {
    const paidUntil = Date.now() + 600000;
    const sessionId = await ctx.db.insert("computeSessions", {
      userId,
      state: "active",
      paidUntil,
      activation: "active",
    });
    const debitId = await ctx.db.insert("computeDebits", {
      sessionId,
      state: "confirmed",
      paidUntil,
    });
    await ctx.db.patch(sessionId, { debitId });
    return { sessionId, debitId };
  },
});
export const snapshot = internalQuery({
  args: { userId: v.string(), appId: v.string(), threadId: v.string() },
  handler: async (ctx, { userId, appId, threadId }) => {
    const app = await ctx.db
      .query("apps")
      .withIndex("by_appId", (q) => q.eq("appId", appId))
      .unique();
    const sessions = await ctx.db
      .query("computeSessions")
      .withIndex("by_userId", (q) => q.eq("userId", userId))
      .take(10);
    const messages = await listMessages(ctx, components.agent, {
      threadId,
      paginationOpts: { numItems: 10, cursor: null },
    });
    const row = await ctx.db.query("publicAdmissionTransport").first();
    const debits = sessions[0]
      ? await ctx.db
          .query("computeDebits")
          .withIndex("by_sessionId", (q) => q.eq("sessionId", sessions[0]._id))
          .take(10)
      : [];
    return {
      app,
      sessions,
      debits,
      messages: messages.page,
      calls: row?.calls,
    };
  },
});
